answer: Deposits are visible in oasis, and ridge reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 15% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 189 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. The attacker spends 22 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
